scope: Unweighted nominal bin-centered result, for the 5D baseline comparison and physics injection. 3D BC_RC_Bayesian phi_h in the copy of corrected/unweighted/bc/corrected.root, Q2-y 1-17. Bayesian, RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D were absent and were not created. --Apply_BC was not passed. The refined spline nominal was not copied onto these histograms. No publication. The source file and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. corrected/unweighted/rc was not refit.
start_mode: spline. start=auto: a BC_RC histogram selects untagged or BC keys, not the tight 3D acceptance windows. Those selected B widths have median 0.17, and 305 of 452 have no B window. The run-local guide started as Prepare_Next_Iteration/Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_from_Spline.py. --use_spline_init was not also passed.

left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. The refined spline nominal BC value B=-0.116 was not used for (1, 8): this histogram is nearly flat, with a dip near 180 degrees inside the errors, and the free cosine is B=0.015 with error 0.041 and C=-0.020 with error 0.027. Opening that C limit is not required. Bins whose retained curve already matches the unconstrained cosine were not pulled toward a neighbor. Collapsed parameter errors that remain are a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty: (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) C, (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_14) B, (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_21) C, (Q2_y_Bin_4)-(z_pT_Bin_29) C, (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_13) B, (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_19) B, (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_25) B, (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_7) C, (Q2_y_Bin_8)-(z_pT_Bin_30) C.
unresolved: No bin has reduced chi-squared at or above 4. The largest remaining values are histogram shape, and the retained cosine already matches an unconstrained fit. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_32) 3.850 (chi2 80.841, NDF 21.0); (Q2_y_Bin_12)-(z_pT_Bin_24) 3.725 (chi2 55.868, NDF 15.0); (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_26) 3.069 (chi2 64.456, NDF 21.0). overlay: overlays/bc_final.png is the retained curve. overlays/bc_review.png draws the stored curve in blue and the retained curve in red on the same filled phi window.
why_retained: Pass 2 is kept because the twelve spline-pass regressions returned to the cosine those BC histograms support, and the nine opened bins have lower chi-squared than the stored fit on each histogram's own cosine. No histogram is worse than the stored fit. (1, 8) was not replaced by the spline nominal or by the pinned acceptance-variation value.
